items.stem: A Python script recomputes a subtotal and gets a different number than the workbook. What should you confirm first?

options.text: That the script reads the same cell range the workbook sums
options.rationale: Correct: a range mismatch is a common cause of a false discrepancy.

options.text: That the workbook is definitely wrong
options.rationale: The script, not the workbook, may be reading the wrong range.

options.text: That Python is always more accurate than Excel
options.rationale: Neither tool is automatically correct; the inputs decide.

options.text: That the difference can be ignored
options.rationale: An unexplained difference must be investigated, not ignored.

items.explanation: Correct: a range mismatch is a common cause of a false discrepancy.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO steps keep a Claude-written variance narrative reliable? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Check the narrative against the recomputed figures
options.rationale: Correct: verification catches AI explanations that do not match the data.

options.text: Record the caveats and limitations the narrative depends on
options.rationale: Correct: stating limitations keeps the conclusion honest.

options.text: Publish the narrative without reading the numbers
options.rationale: Unchecked narratives can contradict the data.

options.text: Delete figures that disagree with the narrative
options.rationale: Deleting inconvenient figures falsifies the review.

items.explanation: Correct: verification catches AI explanations that do not match the data.

items.stem: Why set materiality thresholds at the start of a quality review?

options.text: To focus attention on variances large enough to matter
options.rationale: Correct: materiality directs effort to findings that affect decisions.

options.text: Because it guarantees the model is error-free
options.rationale: Thresholds triage findings; they do not prove correctness.

options.text: Because it removes the need to trace formulas
options.rationale: Tracing is still required for flagged items.

options.text: Because small variances are always errors
options.rationale: Small variances may be immaterial and expected.

items.explanation: Correct: materiality directs effort to findings that affect decisions.
